modules.module_title: Perform basic blow drying of hair

pcs.pc_description: comply with health and safety standards and processes laid out by manufacturer and the establishment, to protect self, co-workers, organisation and customers/visitors

• use suitable consultation techniques to identify the clients wishes for the desired look before carrying out blow drying procedure including with guardians/parents for minors • Consultation techniques: eg. ask questions, catalogue of styles, chart or image referencing, etc.
ensure a guardian/parent is present for minors under age
carry out the process using the tools and materials as laid down by the salon
confirm blow drying requirements and any special instructions with the client
• apply hair products, if required, following the stylist's instructions • Products: Hair spray, cream, mousse, gel, etc.

• use techniques and carry out checks to minimise the risk of damage to the hair and client discomfort • Techniques and checks: Setting of dryer, direction of blow drying, duration and movements, moisturising hair prior to drying, not drying out fully, shampooing hair prior, drying with wet towel first, applying products, blowing cool air to end, etc.
blow dry using sections of hair that are convenient and efficient and as per styling tool size
check regularly whether client is comfortable during the drying process, if not, work to increase comfort levels
maintain even tension throughout the blow drying process
check temperature of the styling equipment to ensure it is in comfortable and approved range
use back combing and back brushing techniques to achieve desired look
• use tools and equipment effectively to achieve the required result • Tools: Blow dryer, comb, etc.
ask questions to check with the client their satisfaction with the finished result
use finger drying to shape hair, achieve volume, balance, direction and desired look
use flat brush/paddle brush to straighten hair
• use thermal/rollers for hair setting with curls • Rollers: Heated rollers, Rollers with pins
work minimising wastage of products

thank customer for feedback post-service, where customer is not satisfied with service, take actions to resolve matter to customer satisfaction or refer to supervisor if actions beyond scope of authority or no action is possible to mitigate damage
provide specific after-care advice to the client to maintain and protect hair from damage, frequency of future services, etc.
